title: PFCP: Add dissection for Juniper Network Instance IEs (32925–32928)
description:
Implements dissection support for the Juniper-specific grouped IE
PFCP_JNPR_NETWORK_INSTANCE_PORT_ADDRESS_LIST (32925),
nested in BBF Network Instance Report IE 32798.

The IE contains nested instances of PFCP_JNPR_NETWORK_INSTANCE_ADDRESS (32926),
which in turn group the following 2 IEs:
- PFCP_JNPR_ADDRESS_QUALIFIER (32927): bitmask for Primary/Preferred flags
- PFCP_JNPR_OPERATION_TYPE (32928): bitmask for Add/Delete/Modify operations
